answer: Plant decoys with known wrong answers and count who copies them. One returned decoy costs the farm a whole identity, not one reward. A claim that fresh work does not renew expires, so an old pass cannot carry a new epoch. A quorum counts only if the signers sit in unrelated subnetworks, which prices a single-rack farm out of the vote. Ten clones on one terrace share an exit and a verdict, and no amount of pigment paints them into separate identities. The meadow looks full until you count the roots.
